direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi's attention shifts from her returned phone to Kasun's small food business. Its modest scale gives her growing interest something tangible.

flow.text: The small food three-wheeler sits still in the shaded right side of the view, enclosed on one side by its near frame edge. Light rain falls beyond it.
Hold on the modest business as rain continues along the exposed vehicle edge. No person, hand or phone enters the frame.

direction.camera: A locked-off medium detail view on a 50mm lens holds Anudi's roadside eyeline toward the three-wheeler, with its near frame edge enclosing one side, in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant road wash; no speech and no music.
